description: This file contains unit tests for the absl::random_internal::randen_engine, including tests for reseeding, discard, serialization, interface compliance, golden value checks, and performance timing.

classes.name: RandenEngineTypedTest
classes.description: Template test fixture for randen_engine with different unsigned integer types.

methods.name: VerifyReseedChangesAllValues
methods.description: Tests that reseeding the engine changes the output sequence and bits as expected.

methods.name: VerifyDiscard
methods.description: Tests the discard functionality of the engine to ensure it produces consistent results.

methods.name: StreamOperatorsResult
methods.description: Checks that stream insertion and extraction operators work correctly for the engine.

methods.name: StreamSerialization
methods.description: Tests serialization and deserialization of the engine state.

methods.name: RandomNumberEngineInterface
methods.description: Verifies that the engine meets the C++ random number engine interface requirements.

methods.name: RandenEngineSFINAETest
methods.description: Tests for SFINAE constraints and construction options of the engine.

methods.name: VerifyGoldenRanden64Default
methods.description: Checks that the default engine produces expected golden output values.

methods.name: VerifyGoldenRanden64Seeded
methods.description: Checks that a seeded engine produces expected golden output values.

methods.name: VerifyGoldenRanden32Default
methods.description: Checks that the default 32-bit engine produces expected golden output values.

methods.name: VerifyGoldenRanden32Seeded
methods.description: Checks that a seeded 32-bit engine produces expected golden output values.

methods.name: VerifyGoldenFromDeserializedEngine
methods.description: Verifies that deserialized engine state produces consistent output.

methods.name: IsFastOrSlow
methods.description: Measures the performance of the engine to determine if it is fast or slow.
